mechanism_predicates.expected: top_minus_bottom_reached_base_rate > 0, over at least 6 plate appearances per order half
mechanism_predicates.subject: backed_lineup_vs_opposing_starter

thesis: Backing the home side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) this lineup's top-of-order minus bottom-of-order strength (top_minus_bottom; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 0.029 wOBA, home 0.059 wOBA (this game's own values rest on: away over 5,341 plate-appearance denominators; home over 4,730 plate-appearance denominators); a gap of 0.031 wOBA, clearing the threshold of 0.023 wOBA (rung 1 of 3, the 50th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 4,838 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). This mechanism's direction was frozen before any search ran at +1 (the side holding more of it is the side the mechanism favours), so the signal points to the home side. Pre-registered reason it should matter: a top-heavy order concentrates its best bats where the extra plate appearances go, and club-level pricing averages that concentration away; the weakest mechanism of the six, kept because V4 stated it before seeing its result. This is a signal count, not a forecast: it publishes no probability of its own, says nothing about whether the market's price is mistaken, and attaches no claim of value -- none has been earned. (Strategy: evolab genome ec712e93b6b9d771.)

This mechanism's direction was frozen before any search ran at +1 (the side holding more of it is the side the mechanism favours), so the signal points to the away side. Pre-registered reason it should matter: concentration in one pitch is predictability: the more of a starter's arsenal is a single offering, the more of the lineup's preparation transfers, and pitch-level lean is not a term in any club-level price. This is a signal count, not a forecast: it publishes no probability of its own, says nothing about whether the market's price is mistaken, and attaches no claim of value -- none has been earned. thesis: Backing the home side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) this lineup's top-of-order minus bottom-of-order strength (top_minus_bottom; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 0.029 wOBA, home 0.059 wOBA (this game's own values rest on: away over 5,341 plate-appearance denominators; home over 4,730 plate-appearance denominators); a gap of 0.031 wOBA, clearing the threshold of 0.023 wOBA (rung 1 of 3, the 50th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 4,838 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). Pre-registered reason it should matter: a top-heavy order concentrates its best bats where the extra plate appearances go, and club-level pricing averages that concentration away; the weakest mechanism of the six, kept because V4 stated it before seeing its result. This is a signal count, not a forecast: it publishes no probability of its own, says nothing about whether the market's price is mistaken, and attaches no claim of value -- none has been earned. The direction and the p_model are fixed conventions written down in code before any board was read -- never fit, never derived from price or a clock -- and provenance=placeholder means no edge_bps can ever be computed for it. That is the point: it is the baseline every real system has to beat (src.engine.glue).

counterarguments.detail: DEGRADED_INFORMATION: away_lineup: not present in assumption_exposure; home_lineup: not present in assumption_exposure; home_plate_umpire: not present in assumption_exposure

thesis: This pick carries the market's own probability and no edge, by construction. Its p_model is the board's own de-vigged consensus for this exact selection, republished unchanged by analyze()'s PROJECT phase under the identity map -- zero fitted parameters, no recalibration intercept, no Platt, no isotonic refit (docs/PREREG_CALIBRATED_PROBABILITY.md §2). Because the probability IS the price, diffing the two would measure nothing: edge_bps is structurally None and no edge is claimed. It is published as a calibration reference -- how good the market's own number is -- never as a reason to bet.

thesis: Backing the home side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) how far the opposing starter's fastball sits above league pace (starter_velocity_gap; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 2.08 mph, home -0.87 mph (this game's own values rest on: away over 186 measured fastballs; home over 197 measured fastballs); a gap of 2.95 mph, clearing the threshold of 1.96 mph (rung 1 of 3, the 50th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 3,149 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). This mechanism's direction was frozen before any search ran at -1 (the side holding more of it is the side the mechanism harms), so the signal points to the home side. Pre-registered reason it should matter: a starter whose fastball sits above league pace is holding stuff the season line has not caught up to, so the lineup facing the harder thrower is the disadvantaged side; velocity leads results and the market prices results. This is a signal count, not a forecast: it publishes no probability of its own, says nothing about whether the market's price is mistaken, and attaches no claim of value -- none has been earned. thesis: Backing the away side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) this lineup's measured production against the primary pitch of the starter it faces (lineup_vs_primary_pitch; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 0.363 wOBA, home 0.316 wOBA (this game's own values rest on: away over 3,836 plate appearances; home over 1,308 plate appearances); a gap of 0.047 wOBA, clearing the threshold of 0.029 wOBA (rung 1 of 3, the 50th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 4,048 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). mechanism_predicates.claim: the harder-throwing starter -- the one this side is backed BECAUSE its opponent has to face him -- holds that opposing lineup below the league rate starters allow
mechanism_predicates.subject: backed_starter_vs_opposing_lineup

thesis: Backing the home side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) how far the opposing starter's fastball sits above league pace (starter_velocity_gap; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 2.08 mph, home -0.87 mph (this game's own values rest on: away over 186 measured fastballs; home over 197 measured fastballs); a gap of 2.95 mph, clearing the threshold of 1.96 mph (rung 1 of 3, the 50th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 3,149 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). This mechanism's direction was frozen before any search ran at -1 (the side holding more of it is the side the mechanism harms), so the signal points to the home side. Pre-registered reason it should matter: a starter whose fastball sits above league pace is holding stuff the season line has not caught up to, so the lineup facing the harder thrower is the disadvantaged side; velocity leads results and the market prices results. This is a signal count, not a forecast: it publishes no probability of its own, says nothing about whether the market's price is mistaken, and attaches no claim of value -- none has been earned. mechanism_predicates.claim: the top-heavy order's first four slots out-reach its own bottom five against the starter they faced -- the concentration the mechanism claims, in the innings it claims it for
mechanism_predicates.expected: top_minus_bottom_reached_base_rate > 0, over at least 6 plate appearances per order half
mechanism_predicates.subject: backed_lineup_vs_opposing_starter

thesis: Backing the home side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) this lineup's top-of-order minus bottom-of-order strength (top_minus_bottom; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 0.015 wOBA, home 0.045 wOBA (this game's own values rest on: away over 5,938 plate-appearance denominators; home over 8,795 plate-appearance denominators); a gap of 0.030 wOBA, clearing the threshold of 0.023 wOBA (rung 1 of 3, the 50th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 4,838 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). This mechanism's direction was frozen before any search ran at +1 (the side holding more of it is the side the mechanism favours), so the signal points to the home side. Pre-registered reason it should matter: a top-heavy order concentrates its best bats where the extra plate appearances go, and club-level pricing averages that concentration away; the weakest mechanism of the six, kept because V4 stated it before seeing its result. This is a signal count, not a forecast: it publishes no probability of its own, says nothing about whether the market's price is mistaken, and attaches no claim of value -- none has been earned. (Strategy: evolab genome ec712e93b6b9d771.)

mechanism_predicates.claim: the lineup facing the one-pitch-heavy starter reaches base against him at or above the league rate starters allow -- predictability showing up as production
mechanism_predicates.subject: backed_lineup_vs_opposing_starter

thesis: Backing the away side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) the share of pitches the opposing starter throws with his single most-used offering (primary_pitch_share; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 41.0%, home 26.8% (this game's own values rest on: away over 6,444 pitches; home over 1,954 pitches); a gap of 14.2 percentage points, clearing the threshold of 9.7 percentage points (rung 1 of 3, the 50th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 4,061 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). This mechanism's direction was frozen before any search ran at +1 (the side holding more of it is the side the mechanism favours), so the signal points to the away side. Pre-registered reason it should matter: concentration in one pitch is predictability: the more of a starter's arsenal is a single offering, the more of the lineup's preparation transfers, and pitch-level lean is not a term in any club-level price. This is a signal count, not a forecast: it publishes no probability of its own, says nothing about whether the market's price is mistaken, and attaches no claim of value -- none has been earned. (Strategy: evolab genome 6093c1cf8a6d6c08.)

Its p_model is the board's own de-vigged consensus for this exact selection, republished unchanged by analyze()'s PROJECT phase under the identity map -- zero fitted parameters, no recalibration intercept, no Platt, no isotonic refit (docs/PREREG_CALIBRATED_PROBABILITY.md §2). Because the probability IS the price, diffing the two would measure nothing: edge_bps is structurally None and no edge is claimed. It is published as a calibration reference -- how good the market's own number is -- never as a reason to bet.

thesis: This pick carries the market's own probability and no edge, by construction. Its p_model is the board's own de-vigged consensus for this exact selection, republished unchanged by analyze()'s PROJECT phase under the identity map -- zero fitted parameters, no recalibration intercept, no Platt, no isotonic refit (docs/PREREG_CALIBRATED_PROBABILITY.md §2). Because the probability IS the price, diffing the two would measure nothing: edge_bps is structurally None and no edge is claimed. It is published as a calibration reference -- how good the market's own number is -- never as a reason to bet.

thesis: Backing the away side of the moneyline because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) this lineup's measured production against the primary pitch of the starter it faces (lineup_vs_primary_pitch; each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 0.339 wOBA, home 0.278 wOBA (this game's own values rest on: away over 914 plate appearances; home over 1,728 plate appearances); a gap of 0.061 wOBA, clearing the threshold of 0.029 wOBA (rung 1 of 3, the 50th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 4,048 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). This mechanism's direction was frozen before any search ran at +1 (the side holding more of it is the side the mechanism favours), so the signal points to the away side. Pre-registered reason it should matter: a starter who leans on one pitch, against a lineup that has measurably hit that pitch, has nowhere to hide for eighteen outs; the market prices his season line, not tonight's specific collision. This is a signal count, not a forecast: it publishes no probability of its own, says nothing about whether the market's price is mistaken, and attaches no claim of value -- none has been earned.
